name: ROLO Pastelaria
verdict: Brand of Grupo Rolo, a Portuguese industrial pastry group (Óbidos) founded in 1995 that describes itself as a family business. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (2026-10-03): 'ROLO PASTELARIA' sits on the lower back of Marítimo's 2026-27 home shirt (official retail photos). Grupo Rolo's site says it launched the ROLO brand in October 2025 and calls itself a family business; the owning family is not named anywhere accessible. No human-rights finding found.
